description: Project for the construction of Interim Housing for families displaced due to the disasters caused by the Cyclone Ditwah and currently residing in safety centres, tents and houses of relatives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 6,088 houses were completely damaged and 115,179 houses partially damaged due to the impact of the Cyclone Ditwah. Of these families, 494 families are staying in 20 safety centres in 04 Districts of the Country as of 2026-04-22, while a number of other families are staying in tents and houses of relatives. Further, although actions have been taken to provide a monthly rental allowance of Rs.25,000/- to families who have lost their homes due to landslides and floods and have no place to settle until a new house is built, it has been observed that obtaining houses for rent in those areas has become a problem. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement a project to construct interim housing for 1,000 families residing in safety centres, tents and relatives’ houses in the Districts of Kegalle, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Badulla due to the damage to their houses by the disasters caused by the Cyclone Ditwah, utilizing the labour contribution of the Sri Lanka Army and in accordance with the housing plan submitted by the National Building Research Organization, until permanent houses are built for them, was approved by the Cabinet.
